question_stem:
Part of a circuit incorporating an operational amplifier (op-amp) is shown in Fig. 9.1.
{{figure:figure_9_1}}

parts.label: (a)
parts.part_stem: A relay is connected to the output of the op-amp circuit so that a lamp may be switched on or off.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Complete Fig. 9.1 to show the relay connected into the circuit.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State and explain whether the output of the op-amp is positive or negative for the lamp to be switched on.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem: State the device in Fig. 9.1 that could be used so that the circuit indicates a change in:

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: the level of daylight to switch on a street light.
